## What MethodMesh is now

MethodMesh has two equal jobs. It lets a person use the phone as a practical field toolbox, and it lets external systems call those same capabilities through a stable method contract. The dashboard is important, but it is only one projection of that contract. Capabilities must remain independently addressable from direct native use, presets, protocols, schedules, widgets and ODK/XLSForm.

<div class="mm-rule"><strong>Canonical rule:</strong> define a capability once. Project it into every interaction surface. Do not create dashboard-only behaviour, preset-only outputs, or a second ODK schema.</div>

## Product model

The top-level app model is **Dashboard · Presets · Protocols · Capabilities · Workbench · Device registry · Settings · Widgets**. The phone should feel like a toolbox rather than a database-management application. Results are primary; provenance, diagnostics, manifests and raw JSON remain available without dominating routine use.

The [Master Book v1.05](reference/master-book.qmd) is the normative working doctrine used for this refresh. The [current reference library](reference/modules/index.qmd) is additionally reconciled against the supplied `src` snapshot so it documents capabilities that have appeared since the older website catalogue was written.
